name: Texthelp Read&Write
description: Commercial literacy-support software with text-to-speech, dictionaries, word prediction, dictation, screen masking, highlighting and related reading/writing tools across several platforms.
intended_use: Inspect a bundle of reading and writing access tools used in education, DSA and workplace contexts.
audience_or_context: Students, workers and other users who need alternative ways to read, compose, check or organise digital text.
limitations: Available features differ by platform, licence and product edition.
Provider case studies and benefit claims are not independent evidence that the software will improve outcomes for a particular person.
cost_or_access_notes: Access may be provided through a school, college, employer or Disabled Students' Allowance, or may require a commercial licence.
conflicts_of_interest: Texthelp develops and sells Read&Write and publishes training, testimonials and impact material about its own product; ND Oracle records this commercial interest.

provenance.method: Current first-party identity, access route and stated function checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records what the resource is and how to reach it without adopting provider claims of benefit.
